description: This is a Perl script that acts as a replacement for brcmImagebuilder, used for creating and manipulating firmware images for some embedded systems, particularly involving kernel and root filesystem images. It includes functions for reading image files, padding data, and generating custom firmware images with headers.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into a scalar buffer.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the padding length needed to align data to a specified block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align to a specified block size, after an optional offset.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Constructs a firmware image with a specific header, including kernel and root filesystem data, and writes it to the output file.
